description: Estimate the total network space (storage) between two blocks. Returns the estimated netspace in bytes. Provide header hashes of a newer and older block. To obtain header hashes, first call `get_block_record_by_height` for each height, then use the returned `header_hash` values.

newer_block_header_hash.description: Header hash of the newer (more recent) block (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex)

older_block_header_hash.description: Header hash of the older block (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex)

name: get_network_space
